dataset.description_md: Dissolved iron (Fe) concentrations from CalCOFI cruises in the southern California Current System, Nov. 2002 - July 2004 (completed). Surface (0 m) samples collected with a pole sampler, analyzed by FeLume flow-injection analysis. The source also carries total iron (no real values) and a shipboard iron-addition bioassay response (Chla response to Fe+, units unconfirmed); neither is released yet.

status.blockers: Ingested and rendered in R (PR #116 review fixes, 2026-10-01): 170 samples, 170 dissolved_iron obs, validation PASSED. Only dissolved_iron is released: chl_response_to_fe is held out until provider Q01 (units/meaning; open + blocker) and total_iron is not registered (no real value in EDI revision 3; 170/170 are the -999 sentinel). Still open with the provider (Kathy Barbeau): Q01, Q04 (units, detection limit, 0.05 floor), Q07 (operational definition, contamination/QC); proposed pending confirmation: Q02 (PST = fixed UTC-8), Q05 (dissolved_iron valid_max 50), Q06 (-999 sentinel). Sample key is study_name-index_number (not row position).
status.publish_policy: Archive of record: CCE-LTER's EDI package knb-lter-cce.21.3 (Barbeau), the ingest's source -- never republished by CalCOFI. OBIS does not apply (pure chemistry, no occurrences). CalOOS: planned (this holding originated from the CalOOS dataset-inventory intake).
